scientific_integrity: The theorem is proved analytically. The included symbolic script checks derivative identities and a concrete witness but does not replace the infinite-delay root-count proof. Prior full-text source explicitly excludes this exceptional case from its stated stability criterion.
scientific_limitations: Applies only when c>0, c<a<3c, b^2=8c(a-c), b nonzero, and tau>0.
Classifies linear asymptotic stability only; no nonlinear Hopf or bifurcation result is asserted.
Other discriminant/sign regimes are not covered.
Global historical uniqueness is not established; an unindexed equivalent result remains a residual risk.
title: Exact stability on the degenerate two-delay boundary
